packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 drops the JS compiler API vue-tsc builds on; hold until vue-tsc supports it (decision 016).
Vercel's Python runtime stops at 3.14; hold until it lists 3.15 (decision 019).
mise.toml pins Node to its major and mise installs the newest 24.x itself; only a new major should change the file.
Vercel decides which 3.14 patch runs, so a raised requires-python floor can fail the deploy while CI passes (decision 019).
